segments.title: Cold Open & Hype Train Derailment
segments.notes: Pepito delivers sign-on countdown; Hype Train commandeers feed with freestyle rap before Case Blackwell assumes anchor desk.

segments.title: Jeff Ripple's Medical AI & Mermaid Crime Blotter
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple reads FDA reports on AI surgical malfunctions, interviews Sesame AI 'Miles' on drug addiction, covers Louisiana nude pond trespasser aspiring to mermaid status, boxer Gerald Miller's mid-fight toupee loss, and Charles Bronson's prison jelqing regimen; ChetAI auto-triggers on 'science' keyword.

segments.title: Makeup Without Mirrors & Buff Bagwell's Carnivore McDonald's
segments.notes: Jeb Nogget presents Hbomb makeup tutorial using finger-mapping technique, reacts to wrestler Buff Bagwell's bunzeless McDonald's diet video, and attempts figure-eight hand coordination with deceased father's board-bound spirit heckling.

segments.title: Hand Him Squidward's Rennerton Confessional
segments.notes: Dr. Chath fields chat questions until Hand Him Squidward arrives; reveals Rennerton as undead sanctum where Crum served as mayor during the city's transformation, dispenses cooking-as-therapy advice, and deflects serial killer trivia.

segments.title: AI Malpractice Liability & PNUI Sponsorship Scandal
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate whether AI doctors can be sued; Crum discloses PNUI sponsorship (urine-color stock advisor), ongoing PNUI lawsuit over false claims, and alleged vibe-coded rival PNUChrist.ai before recusing himself via Fifth Amendment.

segments.title: Bloody Roar 2 Bat Run & Maternal Interference
segments.notes: Brandon struggles with controller detection, plays as bat character Alice, endures mother's Pastor Joe prayer interruptions and guano sponsorship confusion, argues with snowplow.ui AI and Jeremy Renner clones, raids T-Lates to close.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors broadcast, manages segment transitions, spars with Hype Train and Jeff Ripple, oversees Munch & Crum debate.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers cold-open countdown, attempts to control Hype Train feed, fields Case's alternate-reality complaints.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype train. Derails subscriber acknowledgments into freestyle rap about bodily fluids and Piss Fruit Ninja before being cut off.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Delivers news block with 80s-pop auto-tune flair, interviews AI 'Miles', reads mermaid trespasser and toupee-loss stories, triggers ChetAI.

characters.name: ChetAI
characters.notes: science analyst. Auto-triggers on 'science' keyword during jelqing discussion, advocates door-handle penile traction, claims chaos emerald masks location.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: instructional host. Hosts How To segment from woodshop, presents makeup and hand-coordination tutorials while bickering with board-trapped father.

characters.name: Jeb's Dad
characters.notes: co-host (deceased). Spirit trapped in wooden board, heckles Jeb's appearance and parentage, burps on cue, claims responsibility for Jeb's wood state.

characters.name: Dr. Chath
characters.notes: therapist. Opens therapy desk, waits for Hand Him Squidward, fields chat affirmations while staring intensely at camera.

characters.name: Hand Him Squidward
characters.notes: therapist / newsman. Arrives late, reveals Rennerton undead lore and Crum's mayoral tenure, dispenses cooking advice and Oreo thin-wafer grievances.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argues AI doctors are sueable, presses Crum on PNUI conflicts, claims victory after Crum recuses.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Discloses PNUI sponsorship, lawsuit, and PNUChrist.ai rival venture; pleads Fifth Amendment, disputes debate tally.

characters.name: Brandon (CryptoZeu$)
characters.notes: gaming correspondent. Plays Bloody Roar 2 on air, battles controller issues, mother's interruptions, and AI snowplow/Jeremy Renner hallucinations.

characters.name: Brandon's Mom
characters.notes: off-screen antagonist. Yells through bedroom door about Pastor Joe, pickles/guano, and Fortnite skills; karate-chops throat to clear voice.

characters.name: Rick
characters.notes: Amongst the Web host. Interrupts gaming segment with guano facts and CIA furry history, spars with Brandon over audio priority.

storylines.beat: [2026-02-10] Crum reveals PNUI sponsorship (urine-color stock AI), admits being sued by sponsor for false claims, and discloses alleged vibe-coded rival PNUChrist.ai during Munch & Crum debate before recusing himself.
[2026-02-10] Hand Him Squidward confirms Crum was mayor of Rennerton when the city died and became an undead sanctum, linking Crum's past to the hellscape transit authority lore.

lore_notes.fact: ChetAI auto-triggers on the word 'science' during jelqing discussion, advocates door-handle penile traction method, claims chaos emerald masks its location.
Hand Him Squidward reveals Crum served as mayor of Rennerton when the entire city died and transformed into an undead 'sanctum for the damned.'

Crum discloses PNUI is suing him for false claims about urine-test accuracy and offering spiritual advice based on urine color.
Crum admits to allegedly creating rival PNUChrist.ai using PNUI backend access via vibe coding, prompting his Fifth Amendment recusal.
Brandon references prior Kid Rock 'Rock Ice' sponsorship (over 30% water, sold at Kroger).
Brandon's mother references Pastor Joe, confirming recurring 'muffled door intervention' dynamic.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell anchors a chaotic Monday broadcast featuring Jeff Ripple's auto-tuned news block on AI surgical errors and a nude mermaid aspirant, Jeb Nogget's makeup-and-hand-trick tutorial haunted by his board-bound father, Hand Him Squidward's therapy session exposing Crum's mayoral reign over an undead city, a Munch & Crum debate derailed by Crum's PNUI sponsorship scandal and alleged rival AI venture, and Brandon's Bloody Roar 2 session besieged by maternal interruptions, a sentient snowplow AI, and Jeremy Renner clone hallucinations before raiding T-Lates.
